endpoints.name: custom_menus_get_custom_menu_by_id
endpoints.description: Get Custom Menu Link Fetches a single custom menus based on id. This endpoint allows clients to retrieve custom menu configurations, which may include menu items, categories, and associated metadata [GET /custom-menus/{customMenuId}] Token: agency. Scopes: custom-menu-link.readonly.

customMenuId.description: Unique identifier of the custom menu

endpoints.name: custom_menus_update_custom_menu
endpoints.description: Update Custom Menu Link Updates an existing custom menu for a given company. Requires authentication and proper permissions. [PUT /custom-menus/{customMenuId}] Token: agency. Scopes: custom-menu-link.write.

customMenuId.description: ID of the custom menu to update

icon.description: Icon information for the custom menu

showOnCompany.description: Whether the menu must be displayed on the agency's level (default: true)

showOnLocation.description: Whether the menu must be displayed for sub-accounts level (default: true)

showToAllLocations.description: Whether the menu must be displayed to all sub-accounts (default: true)

openMode.description: Mode for opening the menu link

locations.description: List of sub-account IDs where the menu should be shown. This list is applicable only when showOnLocation is true and showToAllLocations is false

userRole.description: Which user-roles should the menu be accessible to?

allowCamera.description: Whether to allow camera access (only for iframe mode)

allowMicrophone.description: Whether to allow microphone access (only for iframe mode)

endpoints.name: custom_menus_delete_custom_menu
endpoints.description: Delete Custom Menu Link Removes a specific custom menu from the system. This operation requires authentication and proper permissions. The custom menu is identified by its unique ID, and the operation is performed within the context of a specific company. [DELETE /custom-menus/{customMenuId}] Token: agency. Scopes: custom-menu-link.write.

customMenuId.description: ID of the custom menu to delete

endpoints.name: custom_menus_get_custom_menus
endpoints.description: Get Custom Menu Links Fetches a collection of custom menus based on specified criteria. This endpoint allows clients to retrieve custom menu configurations, which may include menu items, categories, and associated metadata. The response can be tailored using query parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination. [GET /custom-menus/] Token: agency. Scopes: custom-menu-link.readonly.

query.description: Search query to filter custom menus by name, supports partial || full names

showOnCompany.description: Filter to show only agency-level menu links. When omitted, fetches both agency and sub-account menu links. Ignored if locationId is provided

endpoints.name: custom_menus_create_custom_menu
endpoints.description: Create Custom Menu Link Creates a new custom menu for a company. Requires authentication and proper permissions. For Icon Usage Details please refer to https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-243696/d60fa70db6b92b2 [POST /custom-menus/] Token: agency. Scopes: custom-menu-link.write.
